rules: Never log token values; log token family ids only.
Every database change ships with a reversible migration.
Feature flag auth.rotation guards the rollout.

review.reason: One-line flag registration covered by its check.

notes: Changes apply in order to the current draft document; the result must be schema-valid or nothing is saved (SCHEMA_INVALID).
merge_patch follows RFC 7396: null deletes a key, arrays are replaced whole. id, key (use rekey), unit item prefix and check owner are owned fields (FIELD_OWNED).
The added item gets a UUIDv7 id and the defaults planning.defaults.route_class/route_effort for its route because it has none.
rekey P2.3 -> P2.5 rewrites every reference: batches, depends_on, criteria owners, check owners (P2.3:V1 -> P2.5:V1), decision applies_to, read refs, review.covers, requirement owners.
